module.Title: Trigger a Temperature Alarm
module.Teaching: An if statement runs its indented block only when its condition is True.
module.PredictionQuestion: When does the alarm message run?
PredictionOptions: Only when the fan is off
module.PredictionExplanation: The greater-than comparison becomes True above the setpoint.
module.DebugPrompt: Python needs a colon after the condition and indentation inside the block.
module.RecallPrompt: Write the high-temperature alarm from memory. Use the exact identifier print. Use these exact values: 30, "High temperature alarm".
module.TransferPrompt: Print a low-level alarm when tank_level is below 20. Use the exact identifier print. Use the exact value "Low tank level".
module.PreviewMessage: The controller now reacts to a high temperature.
